description:
The scheme is for the addition of a ground and first floor rear extension to the property on 5 Brookhill Road EN48SE. This solution improves the value of the accomodation, increasing the quality of the interior and providing additional living space.
The proposal has been carefully designed in accordance to the Local Plan SPD: Residential Design Guidance in order to minimise the impact on the neighbouring properties.
The proposed ground floor rear extension measures 4.50m in depth. The decision to extend the additional volume to 4.50 m, rather than the standard 3.50 m, is due to the neighbouring property at No. 3 having prior approval for a 6 m extension. Our proposal therefore serves as a transitional element between the volume of No. 7, which has an already built extension of 3.50 m and that of No. 3.
The first-floor rear extension measures 4.42 m in length and 2.20 m in depth — dimensions carefully selected to ensure that the outlook of the neighbouring property remains unobstructed.
The design of the first-floor extension is directly informed by the previously approved loft development. This relationship influences the proposed overall massing of the new extension and underpins the decision to incorporate a flat roof.
The choice of materials is in complimentary to the current state of the dwelling, which has red brick walls, a brown-tiled roof and white-framed windows.
The extensions feature a light beige brick, while the top part of the volumes is bordered by a parapet with a soldier bond brick pattern, which adds a point of interest to the design.
